clip_research.source_claim: The number of homes sold in the Nashville metro area that were in the nation's top one percent by price has tripled since 2017.
clip_research.public_baseline: Bloomberg's own review of Realtor.com data reports Nashville metro top-1%-by-price home sales (about $3 million or more in 2025) tripled since 2017, with total ultraluxury sales up 208%, versus a 39% decline in New York City.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The tripled figure is corroborated by the publisher's own reporting, so it is not a surprise reversal; the notable gap is that Nashville, once a relative bargain, has nearly closed its price gap with New York and Los Angeles.
